name: Auto Trajectory
description: Auto play bot with a live jump trajectory overlay.

auto-play.name: Auto Play
auto-play.description: Predictive auto play for cube/robot/ball, ship/UFO/swing/wave and dual mode. Tap input edges are synchronized with prediction; robot holds are frame-timed. Not available in platformer levels.

show-trajectory.name: Show Trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Draws the predicted path for holding and releasing jump.

trajectory-steps.name: Trajectory Length
trajectory-steps.description: How many physics substeps (240 per second) of the future to draw.

autoplay-lookahead.name: Auto Play Lookahead
autoplay-lookahead.description: How far ahead (physics substeps, 240 per second) the bot plans. Longer values let it set up chains of jumps (e.g. pillar staircases). It still jumps at the last safe moment.

wave-room-aware.name: Wave: Roomy Path (experimental)
wave-room-aware.description: Wave tries several hold/release patterns and prefers the one with the most room around it. Uses several times more CPU than the default wave bot, so it may lower FPS on weaker phones.

show-ui.name: Show In-Game Buttons
show-ui.description: Shows the Auto Play / Trajectory toggle buttons while playing.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Writes the bot's decisions to the Geode log whenever its action changes (and every few frames near a hazard). Turn on and send the log if the bot misbehaves.
